format: POP Series 2 (P2, 2005): cards not already in the pool. Unlimited only. Pidgeot 2 and Multi Technical Machine 01 9 (Expedition's), Ivysaur 7 (FireRed & LeafGreen's), Mr. Briney's Compassion 8 (Dragon's), Pokémon Park 10 (Aquapolis'), TV Reporter 11 (Celestial Storm's) and Pikachu 16 (the Classic Collection's) are prints of cards already in the pool.

attacks.name: Stomp
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage.

attacks.name: Fire Spin
attacks.text: Discard 2 Basic Energy cards attached to this Pokémon or this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Roar
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon, if any.

attacks.name: Thunder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.

abilities.name: Mirror Coat
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is Burned or Poisoned by an opponent's attack (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), the Attacking Pokémon is now affected by the same Special Conditions (1 if there is only 1).

attacks.name: Bubblebeam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Rage
attacks.text: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Wide Solarbeam
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Hard Plant
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Hard Plant during your next turn.

attacks.name: Sand Attack
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Paralyzing Kiss
attacks.text: If there are 2 Defending Pokémon in play, choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon. That Pokémon is now Paralyzed. (If there is only 1 Defending Pokémon, this attack does nothing.)

attacks.name: Fast Stream
attacks.text: Move 1 Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon to the other Defending Pokémon. (Ignore this effect if your opponent has only 1 Defending Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Double Spin
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

abilities.name: Time Reversal
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench, you may search your discard pile for a card, show it to your opponent, and put it on top of your deck.

attacks.name: Psychic Shield
attacks.text: Prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon by your opponent's Pokémon-ex during your opponent's next turn.
